name: Неоновый пульт
essence: A calm technical-dashboard language: heavy uppercase captions with a single-word highlight bar, hairline frames with corner brackets, tiny monospace labels, ring timers, dot matrices and a persistent timeline strip; elements glow softly in one accent colour.
material_and_look: Near-black flat field with hairline UI chrome, small technical labels, bracketed frames and dot grids; emissive accent only on active elements.
colour_logic: Near-black with one acid accent for highlight bars and active elements; a warm secondary only for small status marks.
type_and_layout: Bold uppercase captions, slightly rotated, set centre-top in two lines with single words boxed in the accent; small technical labels and data panels around the edges like a dashboard grid.
motion_quality: Calm and measured: words pop in sequentially with highlight bars wiping on, counters tick, scrubbers slide, small dots light up; little camera movement and long holds.
camera_and_transitions: Mostly a locked frame with long holds; an occasional slow push; hard cuts between panels.
sound: Sparse tonal pulse, interface ticks, a soft riser into the final call to action.
cannot_render: filmed-off-a-screen look (draw the screen content full-frame instead)
